findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed rusting on the shelves of the kitchen’s standing freezer. Nonfood contact surfaces should be maintained to be smooth, and easily cleanable. Reseal or replace shelving by the next routine inspection.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. [C]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Two current employees did not have signed reporting agreements on file. One employee started several months ago and the other just started within the recent weeks. PIC had employees sign copies of the reporting agreement during the inspection All other staff, including the PIC, had signed reporting agreements on file. Additional copies of the reporting agreement were provided. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring, and maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff. 
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under ¶ 2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15 Leak was observed at the plumbing under the far right wash basin at the 3 part sink in the kitchen. PIC was made aware and will inform maintenance of the issue so repairs can occur. A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Two of the five spray bottles of quat sanitizer used in classrooms tested at 0-100ppm. The other three solutions were at 200ppm. Solutions below 200ppm were emptied during inspection. Director plans to begin using Purell Foodservice Surface Sanitizer in all the classrooms (see general comments for details). 

A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling.
NOTE: Whatever product is used for sanitizing, make sure it is maintained at proper concentration per product label.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
750.1300 - A spray bottle of sanitizer in one of the classrooms was not labeled as to the contents. Maintain proper labels on all spray bottles.
Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.
findings.citation_text:
750.1320 - Sanitizer solutions in classrooms were observed to be too strong. The concentration registered a dark blue-green color off the chart on the test strips. One bottle was diluted two times in order to get around 150ppm quat. 
Maintain purple power sanitizer at 150-400ppm and Santimine 150 at 200ppm as directed on label instructions for the products used (the label is the law). Use test strips to verify proper concentration.

Chemicals must not be used in any manner that poses a risk of cross contamination or may be harmful to persons exposed to and using the chemical.
NOTE: Director stated all solutions would be remade and properly labeled before afternoon classes were in session

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: 750-140b Observed several bags of American cheese slices without the required date marking. The facility is on break this week and will not likely be back within the seven days allowed to keep opened foods in the facility sure that this food is discarded once returning to the facility IF food has been opened longer than seven days. Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date of preparation or opening and used within seven days.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: 750-830 A spray bottle of Purple Power food contacct quat sanitizer was tested and found to be at a concentration well over 400ppm. Read the labeling requirements for food contact surfaces on this product. Chemical concentration should not exceed 400ppm. Water was added to the bottle to dilute the concentration during the inspection. All chemical sanitizers must meet the requirements of 21 CFR 178.1010 to ensure all items are properly sanitized.  Provide proper sanitizer concentration.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: 750-1350a The same cooler used for storage of preschool foods also stores employee and various other personal foods. Make sure that this refrigerator is cleaned prior to leaving for a vacation or break. There are old bags of personal foods and various wrapped portions of sandwiches. These foods should have been discarded prior to break. Also, personal foods should be stored on the lowest shelf of this cooler. We advise some facilities to go so far as to labeled a tub with 'Personal Foods' and then have staff keep foods limited to the tub. Keep this refrigerator clean and organized.  Food service establishments and all parts of property used in connection with their operation shall be kept free of unnecessary items.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: 830: Facility does not have test strips available for sanitizers. Provide test strips.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 800: Observed the white shelving within the cooler to have accumulation of food on bottom of racks. Clean the shelving.
